Preserve any authentication failure. No fabric claim or repeat dispatch is required after terminal graduation. GateMate has its separate task.

Larger FPGA/TSU purchases remain conditional on a compatible workload and complete cost evidence. Run private E2E-018/021 and original board-reader consumers.

Require 100 percent newly owned statements, including real CLI, child and failure paths. Use pytest -n 0 -o addopts= with private disk-backed scratch. Run the applicable private E2E checks named above. Record commands, exits, durations and log hashes. Keep global repository health separate.

Run unchanged primary_publication checks, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate>. Keep every finding. Only the existing typed consumer may resolve independently recomputed informational findings. Unknown, warning and critical findings block readiness. Do not modify validators or exemptions. Publish checked terminal bytes atomically. Use disqualified for owned validation failure and blocked for unchanged external absence; partial is only retryable unfinished owned work. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. Do not update generator weights or publish externally.
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind results to this exact invocation and task authority.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: Use a complete_ terminal verdict. The closed class is positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. External absence is blocked, never partial.
gate_check_summary: principle: For every blocked_* or complete_blocked_* verdict, name the check, upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected value and observed value. Distinguish absent from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Distinguish current calls from cached observations and small numeric heads.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Preserve every intended unit and arm with its metric and missing reason. Repeated timings are not independent examples.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle-checked positives use circular_positive. Exposed, constructed and feasibility work keeps both generalization scores zero.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Successful execution cannot imply scientific benefit.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Every measurement must be reproducible from sealed operands.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: List imported fields with producer hashes. Explain every added result field.
board_reader_ready_score, operation_rows, unsupported_operations, compatible_cost_fraction: principle: A workload map cannot infer a kernel or speedup that has not run.
kv260_execution_ready_score, polarfire_workload_validated, polarfire_terminal_evidence_hashes, board_obligations: principle: Keep each board status and execution scope separate.
current_device_execution_count, NPU_qualified, TSU_qualified, acquisition_relevance: principle: Vendor findings and desired hardware do not establish current access.
